children: Saba Capital Management, L.P., a 10% Owner, reported purchasing 112,736 shares of Mexico Fund common stock through funds and/or accounts it manages on November 25, 2026, in two transactions, at a weighted average price of $20.15 per share. The total purchase amount was $2,271,239. Saba Capital Management, L.P. indirectly owns 2,813,498 shares following the transactions. Boaz R. Weinstein is the managing member of Saba Capital Management GP, LLC, the general partner of Saba Capital Management, L.P.
